debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-r-o-d-u-c-e-d the f-i-l-e-d p-l-a-n for a-u-t-o-m-a-t-i-n-g l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t t-a-k-e-o-v-e-r-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g the c-a-s-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t o-0-2-1 as the a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-a-l-w-a-r-e s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e s-c-a-n.
2) the a-c-t-o-r b-a-t-c-h-p-r-o-c-e-s-s-e-d g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e d-r-a-i-n-s to i-m-i-t-a-t-e l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e r-e-t-a-i-l c-h-e-c-k-o-u-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g o-r-d-e-r l-o-g e-n-t-r-i-e-s as the a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-l-o-c-i-t-y a-n-o-m-a-l-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-i-n-e-d a-c-c-o-u-n-t f-u-n-d-s into p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l g-o-o-d-s and c-a-s-h e-q-u-i-v-a-l-e-n-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g p-a-y-m-e-n-t j-o-u-r-n-a-l s a-s the a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-u-s-t-l-e-m-b-e-r m-a-t-c-h i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n.
4) the a-c-t-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d l-o-g-i-n a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y to s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e n-o-r-m-a-l b-r-o-w-s-i-n-g s-e-s-s-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-e-s-s-i-o-n h-a-n-d-l-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s as the a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the g-e-o-l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-c-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the a-c-t-o-r l-a-b-e-l-e-d the w-o-r-k-f-l-o-w as an "i-n-n-o-c-e-n-t" a-g-g-r-e-g-a-t-e-d t-a-s-k to d-i-s-g-u-i-s-e i-n-t-e-n-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g the s-e-a-l-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a as the a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-i-g-n-o-f-f r-e-v-i-e-w.
